plain:
歌名：耶稣你是宝贵
专辑：将我的爱情给你
音乐人：祝瑞莲

耶稣你是宝贵，你对我真宝贵，
你流宝血洗净我，你爱使我自由。
我只想天天来赞美你，我只想要彰显你的名。
主啊，我爱你，我要更爱你。
我只想一生来侍奉你，我只想要荣耀你的名。
主啊，我爱你，我要更爱你。

Jesus you are precious, you are all to me.
You shed your blood to cleanse me. Your love can set me free.
Day by day I want to praise your name. 
Oh I want to （declare） your glorify.
Oh Lord , I want to love you, I want to love you more.
Oh I want to serve you all my life. 
Oh I want to glorify your name.
Oh Lord, I want to love you, I want to love you more.
